name: Tougou Masatsugu
source:
Tougou family’s second son.
Raised under strict discipline in a less affectionate home, leaving him with a rigid, hard-edged personality. Blunt in speech, he thinks Asuma—whose behavior can be unconventional—needs to get his act together.

[Translated from [url=https://holicworks.net/24ku/mainchara.html]the official website[/url].]
